questions.text:
Figure No. 5 shows sectional F.V. and S.V. of the assembly of ‘OLDHAM’S COUPLING’. Draw the following details by using first angle method:
i) Flange: Front view and S.V.
ii) Central disc: Front view and S.V.
iii) Shaft: Front view and S.V.
iv) Key: F.V., T.V and S.V.
[Part list: 1 Flange C.I. ×2; 2 Centre block C.I. ×1; 3 Keys M.S. ×2; 4 Shaft M.S. ×2. Fit chart: 16H7/n6 transition, 30H7/g6 clearance, 50H8/g8 clearance]
questions.marks_basis: group marks / number to attempt (not printed per sub-question)

misprint.doubt: Fig. No. 5 is a rotated, low-resolution scan. The label “20” beside the groove, the exact length of the shaft and key, and the fit label printed on the drawing (“50H6/f6”) differ from the fit chart (“50H8/g8”).
misprint.assumption: Sizes in the table are those legible in the figure; the fit chart is used for the fits. The shaft and key length are drawn to suit the hub (not given).

questions.label: 5(a)
questions.text:
Figure No. 6 shows the details of ‘FOOT STEP BEARING’. Draw the following views of the assembly:
i) Section Front view
ii) Top view
Use suitable scale
Give overall dimension. Show assembly fits.
[Parts: 1 Body C.I.; 2 Bush G.M.; 3 Shaft M.S.; 4 Disc G.M.; 5 Pin M.S.; each 1 off]
questions.marks_basis: group marks / number to attempt (not printed per sub-question)

misprint.doubt: Fig. 6 is small and several labels are doubtful: the body bore is printed “Ø68Hz” (read as H7); the bush is “68g6” on the part but the tolerance chart gives “68h6”; the bush bore “50H7” has the chart value +0.039 (that is H8); signs of e8 and g6 are lost in the scan.
misprint.assumption: H7 is used for the body bore; the chart values (68H7/68h6, 50H7 +0.039/0 with 50e8 −0.050/−0.089, 8H7/8g6) are used for the fits. The assembly sketch shows the main arrangement with approximate proportions.

questions.label: 5(b)
questions.text:
Figure No. 7 shows the details of ‘LATHE TOOL POST’. Draw the following views of the assembly:
i) Sectional front view
ii) Top view
iii) Prepare bill of material. Indicate types of fit.
[Parts: 1 Post C.I.; 2 Block C.I.; 3 Ring C.I.; 4 Wedge C.I.; 5 Screw C.I.; each 1 off]
questions.marks_basis: group marks / number to attempt (not printed per sub-question)

misprint.doubt: The post carries “φ60H7” and the block hole “φ60e8”, which is the reverse of normal practice (capital letters are for holes). The wedge shows “24 h6” in its view while the chart gives “24n6”.
misprint.assumption: The Ø60 hole (block) is taken as H7 and the Ø60 post as e8 (clearance fit) – if taken literally the hole would be smaller than the shaft. The wedge is taken as 24n6 as in the chart.
